description: This file exports several functions and types related to testing support for the openclaw plugin SDK, including environment setup, runtime capture, fetch mocking, and configuration types.

methods.name: createCliRuntimeCapture
methods.description: Creates a runtime capture for CLI testing, allowing inspection of commands and outputs.

methods.name: createTempHomeEnv
methods.description: Sets up a temporary home environment for testing purposes.

methods.name: expectGeneratedTokenPersistedToGatewayAuth
methods.description: Asserts that a generated token has been persisted correctly to the gateway authentication.

methods.name: withEnv
methods.description: Runs a function within a specific environment context.

methods.name: withEnvAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously runs a function within a specific environment context.

methods.name: withFetchPreconnect
methods.description: Wraps fetch calls with preconnect logic for testing network pre-initializations.

methods.name: isLiveTestEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether live tests are enabled.
